flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3100/login then Sign in with email bob@ledger.test and password bob123.
Open http://localhost:3100/invoices/4 and verify the page shows "Client: Umbrella".
Click "Sign out".

Navigate to http://localhost:3100/invoices/4 then Sign in with email alice@ledger.test and password alice123.
Open http://localhost:3100/invoices/4.
Verify the page shows "Invoice not found" and that the text "Umbrella" is not on the page.
